_comment: Example dedicated-server config for Fox n Hounds (gamemode 1). Run: python dediserver.py --config configs/foxnhounds.json. Timer mode. The fox's personal clock runs while they are marked; a hound takes the fox by ramming them. Needs 2+ players with cars to start. AI police off so they don't steal the tags.
name: JERICHO Fox n Hounds
motd: Fox n Hounds - catch the fox, then run. Longest time as fox wins.
